rec.name: Product Badges (Tag-driven image labels)

what.text: Small text badges (e.g. "BESTSELLER") overlaid on a corner of the product image. They appear on collection product cards and on the product page media, and are also reused in search and featured collections. Badge text comes from product tags in the format "__label:Bestseller". Theme settings control position (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) and corner radius in px. Badge colors are configured per badge name through a metaobject. The same snippet also shows automatic "Sold out" and discount (% or amount) badges.

why.text: A badge such as "Bestseller" gives social proof and a quick decision cue right where the shopper is looking at the product image. This reduces choice overload in grids and steers attention to winners, promotions and new items. Consistent, color-coded badges let shoppers scan a list quickly and support click-through to the PDP.

how.text: 1) Add a "Product Badges" group to settings_schema.json with two custom label color pairs, a position select (top_left/top_right/bottom_left/bottom_right) and a corner-radius range (0–100px). 2) Create the snippet product-labels.liquid. It loops over product.tags, picks tags containing "__label", and takes the text after the colon. It then looks up the metaobject "product_badge" for an entry whose badge_name equals that text and applies its color and background_color inline. If no entry matches, it falls back to the theme-setting colors (label--custom / label--custom2 for "__label2"). It also outputs a sold-out badge and a discount badge. The snippet's CSS positions .product-item__label-list absolutely inside the image wrapper according to the position setting and applies the border-radius. 3) Render {% render 'product-labels', product: product, reduced_content: reduced_content %} inside .product-item__image-wrapper in product-item.liquid. 4) Render {% render 'product-labels', product: product, reduced_content: false %} inside .product__media-image-wrapper in product-media.liquid. Workflow for merchants: create a metaobject entry (badge name, text color, background color), then add the product tag "__label:<same name>". The two are linked automatically by name matching.

items: Custom label 1 text color and background color (theme settings)
Custom label 2 text color and background color (for __label2 tags)
Position: top left / top right / bottom left / bottom right
Metaobject "product_badge": badge_name, color, background_color (individual per-badge colors)
Discount badge display (percentage or amount) via existing theme settings (show_discount, discount_mode)

dependencies.text: Product tags in the format "__label:Name" ("__label2:Name" for the second style). A Shopify metaobject definition "product_badge" with the fields badge_name, color and background_color (needed for individual colors). A theme with .product-item__image-wrapper and .product__media-image-wrapper containers (code is based on a Maestrooo-style theme), plus theme translation keys for sold out and discount. Needs edits to settings_schema.json, product-item.liquid and product-media.liquid. Metaobjects cannot yet be created via Git or theme files, so they are set up manually in the admin (API creation is planned for a later phase).

items: Collection page product click-through rate (badged vs. non-badged)
Conversion rate and revenue per session on collection pages
Share of revenue from badged products
